notes.title: We're announcing Critical Shift!
notes.notes:
🎬 Today is a truly important day for us — we’re announcing Critical Shift and sharing its first official trailer.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068241/0774e28a1b70648353abfba19147d76e7de7fa11.png[/img]
[previewyoutube=-Gy9umYo748;full][/previewyoutube]
In the trailer, you’ll see gameplay footage, a glimpse of the mysterious atmosphere, and the first strokes of the story we want to tell.
We’ve prepared this gameplay preview so you can already get a sense of the direction the project is taking.
Please note: this is a work in progress — both visuals and gameplay will receive significant improvements as we move closer to release.

Critical Shift is a hardcore turn-based tactical game with RPG elements and a dramatic storyline.
We’re putting everything we have into it: experience, energy, and our love for the genre. We hope that comes through.
Your support — especially by adding the game to your Steam wishlist — means a lot to us.

A few words from the team:
We’ve been working on Critical Shift for several years. It’s the result of long and continuous effort.
Our goal is to create a game we truly want to play ourselves. We've tried to include everything we believe matters, and add the things we've always felt were missing in tactical games.
If what we’re building resonates with you, we’d love to have you follow the game’s development.

notes.title: Video Playback Update
notes.notes:
Hello and thank you for supporting us! 

We were preparing console versions and found a lot things to fix (some Black Screen bugs as well of course :) 

So here's a new version with updated video playback and new German subtitles for English audio! We've made plenty of small fixes in controller support and game stability as well.

notes.title: Big Mac Update
notes.notes:
Hey! 

The She Sees Red version for Mac contained some major and minor bugs so serious that the game was not playable on some systems. We made a serious revision and here comes an update! 

Plenty of fixes including different save-system and subtitles. Some black screen issues ought to disappear as well. Plus update for French and Turkish localization.

notes.title: We're out on iOS and Android!
notes.notes: Hi everyone! We’re happy to announce the release of our first project for the [url=https://apps.apple.com/app/she-sees-red/id1473432173]AppStore[/url] as well as for the [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.RhinoTales.SheSeesAngry]Google Play Store[/url]! Mobile builds got a new interface optimized for touch-screens and include the last update with the Skip feature.

notes.title: Update, SKIP and 25% discount!
notes.notes:
Hey-hey! We’re happy to start our update report with the [b]SKIP feature[/b]! It took some time and a lot of tests, so we hope it’s going to be fine. Let’s go!


[b]1. Skip is available after the second (number 2) playthrough from the Pause menu.[/b] 
	
If you already saw the scene, pressing Skip will make a jump to the last seconds of the scene or the last seconds before next choice. 
	
You can’t skip scenes during the first two playthroughs or if you haven’t seen the scene yet. Also skip isn’t available if the scene playback is in it’s last seconds.
	 
[b]Q[/b]: why not let players skip after the first playthrough?
[b]A[/b]: Usually, for a second playthrough people make different choices and in that case it contains about 2/3 of new content. If we let people skip 1/3 here, it could possibly ruin the story which is kind of complicated. 
	
[b]Q[/b]: I have played the game before this update a couple of times, will the Skip feature be available for me?
[b]A[/b]: Yes. The game counts endings so if you saw two different finale - the Skip is right there for you.
	

[b]2. Subtitle updates for Japanese, Hebrew, Hungarian and Indonesian languages.[/b]
	
[b]3. Minor bug fixes.[/b]


We’re also happy to announce a [b]25% discount starting from September 23![/b]

Thank you for playing our game! Currently, we’re making our way to other platforms and working on ideas for future projects.

notes.title: Underwater
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Moving forward we’re looking for a genre for the next project. 

We have some experience with thrillers and know how to do action so probably we could go for another thriller. With a more straightfoward story maybe, bigger and with a couple of great new features…

But also we’re thinking about a horror. Of course it’s a one of the most obvious and popular genres especially for this kind of media. Although our experience here is kinda smaller, we could give it a try. Please take a look at our movie director’s old work about a girl in a bathroom. What do you think?

notes.title: Fresh update: new languages, scenes counter, ultrawide support
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Here comes a new update:

[b]1. New languages for subtitles:[/b] Traditional Chinese, Brazilian Portuguese, Hungarian, Indonesian and Hebrew.

Our special thanks to mr. Omer Cohen and his gaming group who offered to translate the game to Hebrew on a full volunteer basis!

 [b]2.The Arabic localization has been fixed[/b], please take a look.

[b]3. We've added a counter of scenes been viewed[/b] to the main menu. It can help you with the Timeline achievement. 

4. [b]Support of Ultrawide resolutions. [/b]


[h1]We're also thinking about:[/h1]

- Japanese subtitles update. We asked to check them and now we're waiting for the result.

- SKIP button for scenes been viewed. It's not an easy feature to make in the current game, but we're going to try in the next few weeks when we have time. We think that the best way to activate the SKIP feature is after the second walkthrough in the Pause menu.

notes.title: Big subtitles update + New languages
notes.notes:
Hello dear players, here we come with a big new update!

[b]1. Flashbacks descriptions[/b]

We noticed that sometimes it's not easy to understand where and when a flashback scene was happening. That's why we decided to add description for these scenes. They're short and added right to subtitles. Portuguese and Kazakh languages have no translations for description at this time, but we're going to add them soon. Currently we updated them with English versions.


[b]2. New languages for subtitles: Arabic, Thai and Vietnamese. [/b]

UPD: The Arabic translation doesn't show correctly. We're going to fix it in a few days. 

[b]3. Korean subtitles update.[/b]

We asked a different translator from Korea to read and fix subtitles. Here they are!

[b]4. New translation for Chinese ingame menus, Steam page and achievements.[/b]


[b]COMING SOON:[/b]

- Traditional Chinese translation;
- Indonesian translation.


[b]We're also thinking about:[/b]

- Japanese subtitles update (we're not sure, asked to check the translation);
- Brazilian Portuguese translation;
- Hebrew translation;
- Hungarian translation.

notes.title: She Sees Red is out!
notes.notes:
You can buy it right now with a 10% launch discount.

Thank you for waiting!

At first, we planned to release the game in May, but we decided to make a new English dubbing, add more subtitle languages and do some extra testing.

This is the first project for our indie studio. It took nearly a year to finish and there was more than 100 people involved in the development process. We really hope you'll like it!
	
Right now, both (Russian and English) audio tracks are available as well as subtitles for:

Russian, English, Italian, Spanish, Czech, Polish, French, German, Portuguese, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Turkish and Qazaq.

Soon we're also going to add Traditional Chinese, Thai, Vietnamese and Arabic.

notes.title: She Sees Red: Release Date Change
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35068241/bdec441d3e3cb407a934551de671f4f199e61310.jpg[/img]

Hey! She Sees Red is currently in the testing phase and we decided to spend some more time on fixing bugs and polishing the project. We have dual audio with native Russian and dubbed English which cause some problems with synchronization. 

We're also thinking about making new English dubbing because the feedback on its current quality isn't good at all. Our English-speaking players are very important to us and we want to provide you with the best possible (for our humble indie budget) experience. 

That's why we're moving the release date to "Summer 2019". Thank you for your patience, we're working hard to get our movie-game on Steam ASAP.

P.S.: we've also added another trailer to our store page with original Russian audio and English subtitles, please take a look.
